context.body: Royal sonship appears in a coronation psalm before the Gospel baptism scenes.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The psalm sets rebellion against the LORD and his anointed, then reports the decree, “You are my son.”
observations.label: The king is addressed as son: action

observations.body: The installed king receives the nations and is warned to serve with fear.
observations.label: The king is addressed as son: response

observations.body: anointed · my son · today · take refuge
observations.label: Words in Psalm 2:1–12

payload.posture: Read Psalm 2:1–12 as voices before the jordan evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The psalm’s royal setting must remain visible when its son-language is heard beside the Jordan voice.
payload.title: The king is addressed as son
